name: team_code under a year axis renders the team the player was rostered on, including a season with no active game
description: The player_years_teams bridge deliberately does NOT filter pgl.is_active, so it agrees with the player_year_teams identity bridge that team_*_from_plays attaches to. While it filtered on active and that bridge did not, a player carrying gamelogs but no active REG game rendered a BLANK team_code beside populated team stats -- 5,076 of 53,767 player-years on production (AJ Dillon 2024 GB, Alexander Mattison 2025 MIA). The seeded player has one 2022 gamelog, inactive, on GB while his current team is KC: he must read GB, which pins BOTH halves -- the relaxed filter (not null) and the row axis still routing through the historical bridge (not the current-team fallback).

INSERT INTO nfl_games (esbid, season_year, week, season_type, away_nfl_team, home_nfl_team, date) VALUES (971011, 2022, 1, 'REG', 'GB', 'ZFX', '2022-09-11')
INSERT INTO player_gamelogs (esbid, pid, opponent_nfl_team, nfl_team, player_position, season_year, is_active) VALUES (971011, 'TEST-TMCI-920011', 'ZFX', 'GB', 'MLB', 2022, false)

expected_query:
with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2022]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years WHERE player.primary_position IN ('MLB')), "player_years_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2022::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2022 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2022) src
          GROUP BY pid, year) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, player_years_teams.teams as team_code_0, "player_years"."year", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years" on "player_years"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "player_years_teams" on "player_years_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_teams"."year" = "player_years"."year" where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, player_years_teams.teams, "player_years"."year", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
